node.title: Re: Named Entity alternative to Lingua::EN::NamedEntity
node.author: haukex
node.doctext: The latest release of [mod://Lingua::EN::NamedEntity] is from 2015, which isn't all too old. Plus, the [https://rt.cpan.org/Public/Bug/Display.html?id=85736|issue] in the [id://1035943|thread] you linked to seems to have been resolved in the latest version; [http://matrix.cpantesters.org/?dist=Lingua-EN-NamedEntity+1.93|CPAN Testers] shows no install issues anywhere (including Windows) for the latest 1.93. Perhaps if you can tell us what problem you're having installing it, we can help - see [id://174051]
